item.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_launcher.sight: Sneak + right-click: lock on to what the sight is resting on
item.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_launcher.fire: Right-click: fire — a locked Gipfäli chases its target
item.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_launch_rig.cal: Right-click: call the block the strike lands on
item.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_launch_rig.pla: Right-click again: set the bomb down — 5 seconds, then away
item.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_launch_rig.rea: Sneak + right-click: call a different block
item.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_grenade.desc: Right-click: pull the pin and throw — it bounces, then goes off two seconds after leaving your hand
block.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_tnt.desc: Lights like TNT, goes off twice as hard
block.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_ultra_tnt.des: Lights like TNT, goes off four times as hard, and throws a ring of live hand grenades out of the crater
item.gipfeliarmy.letony_mate_ak47.desc: A three-round burst, decent reach — what most of the squad carries
item.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_shotgun.desc: A fistful of crumbs at once, and nothing at all past a dozen blocks
item.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_marksman.desc: One crumb, hard, from further off than anything else here
item.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_heavy_mg.desc: Off a tank mount. Endless fire, and the weight to match
item.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_war_banner.des: No gun — a marcher carrying this rallies everyone around it
block.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_guard_post.de: Set it down, click it: station soldiers here and set how they guard
item.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_command_flag.r: Right-click the air: sign a soldier on, armed out of your own pack
item.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_command_flag.a: Right-click a target: send the whole squad after it
item.gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli_command_flag.m: Sneak + right-click: list everything on the map to pick from
gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli.bomb.target: Target: %s %s %s — now set the bomb down
gipfeliarmy.gipfaeli.bomb.no_ground: Nothing here to set it down on
gipfeliarmy.army.no_weapon: Nothing in the pack to arm a recruit with
gipfeliarmy.army.no_rations: A recruit signs on for %s Gipfäli
gipfeliarmy.army.none: No squad to give orders to
gipfeliarmy.army.own_side: That one is on your side
gipfeliarmy.army.disabled: The Gipfäli army is switched off
gipfeliarmy.army.gone: Nothing by that name is anywhere about
gipfeliarmy.army.menu.title: GIPFÄLI ARMY
gipfeliarmy.army.order.sighted.hover: Whatever is under your crosshair, out to the launcher's sighting range
gipfeliarmy.army.order.dismiss.hover: Sends everyone home — their kit comes back to you
gipfeliarmy.army.menu.recruit.hover: Costs %s Gipfäli. The recruit comes unarmed — click it to hand it a kit, armour and a colour
gipfeliarmy.army.stance.attack.hover: Back in the field: engage, follow orders, keep the shape
gipfeliarmy.army.stance.stand.hover: On parade, right here, facing the way you face — every squad a block, its commander out in front
gipfeliarmy.army.stance.standfollow.hove: The same ranks, marching after you
gipfeliarmy.army.soldier.title: SOLDIER
gipfeliarmy.army.soldier.kit.hover: Takes a %s from your pack (free in creative)
gipfeliarmy.army.soldier.armour.hover: Puts on every piece of this suit you have in your pack (the whole suit in creative)
gipfeliarmy.army.soldier.gone: That soldier is not yours, or not about
gipfeliarmy.army.soldier.promote.hover: The one soldier of its colour who leads the squad: black uniform, out in front on parade, click it for the whole squad's orders
gipfeliarmy.army.squad.title: SQUAD %s
gipfeliarmy.army.squad.name: Squad %s
gipfeliarmy.army.squad.no_commander: none — promote one from a soldier's menu
gipfeliarmy.army.squad.recruit.hover: Costs %s Gipfäli; the recruit joins this squad unarmed
gipfeliarmy.army.squad.colour.hover: Repaints the whole squad — this is what makes it Squad Red or Squad Blue
gipfeliarmy.army.no_such_squad: No such squad: %s (a colour, camo, or all)
gipfeliarmy.army.squads_full: Every colour already has a squad
gipfeliarmy.army.squad.raised: Squad %s raised — click its commander to fill it
gipfeliarmy.army.squad.spawn.hover: %s unarmed soldiers beside the commander, for %s Gipfäli
gipfeliarmy.army.squad.spawn.fill.hover: As many as the squad has room for and you can pay for
gipfeliarmy.army.order.hold.hover: Stay put; still shoots whatever comes
gipfeliarmy.army.order.follow.hover: Break off and fall back in behind you
gipfeliarmy.army.soldier.post.hover: Go and guard the post at %s %s %s
gipfeliarmy.army.squad.kit.hover: Hands every soldier in the squad a %s from your pack (free in creative)
gipfeliarmy.army.squad.armour.hover: Dresses every soldier in the squad in this suit, as far as your pack stretches (whole suits in creative)
gipfeliarmy.army.squad.dressed: %s pieces of %s armour put on across %s soldiers
gipfeliarmy.army.fortress.built: Fortress raised: %s blocks square, %s guard posts, %s guards — squad %s, commander in the yard
gipfeliarmy.army.training.stood: %s training dummies stood up ahead of you — they take it and don't shoot back
gipfeliarmy.army.training.armed: %s armed training dummies stood up ahead of you — they shoot whoever shoots them
gipfeliarmy.army.formation.parade.hover: Each squad a block of ranks, side by side, commanders out in front
gipfeliarmy.army.manual_given: Field manual added to your pack
gipfeliarmy.army.no_kit: No %s in your pack to hand over
gipfeliarmy.army.stand_march: %s soldiers marching off in their ranks
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.stand_march.hove: March off with you in the ranks they are standing in, turning the way you walk. Stand halts them
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.guard.hover: Each squad to its own guard post - red 1 to the post set to red 1, or else to the one set to red. Set a post's squad on the post's menu
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.number.hover: Which numbered squad the colours above paint into: red 1, red 2 ... Orders for "red" still reach every red squad
gipfeliarmy.army.soldier.squad.hover: Move it to the next numbered squad of its colour: red 1, red 2 ...
gipfeliarmy.army.post.squad.hover: Make this the post of %s and send them here. "Guard" sends them back here any time
gipfeliarmy.army.post.squad.set: This is now the post of %s - %s soldiers on their way
gipfeliarmy.army.post.squad.cleared: This post belongs to no squad now
gipfeliarmy.army.post.squad.no_post: No guard post is set to %s - open a post's menu and pick the squad
gipfeliarmy.army.no_such_camo: No such camouflage: %s (plain, woodland, snow, desert, jungle, urban, night)
gipfeliarmy.army.soldier.camo.hover: Put the next camouflage pattern on: plain, woodland, snow, desert, jungle, urban, night. The squad colour stays on the cap, shoulders and chest
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.camo.hover: Pick a pattern with the arrows, click here to put the whole squad in it. The squad colour stays on the cap, shoulders and chest
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.assault.hover: Pick a side with the arrows, click here to send the squad at all of them - they keep fighting until none are left. Your own other squads fight back
gipfeliarmy.army.assault.start: %s soldiers of %s attacking %s × %s - until none are left
gipfeliarmy.army.assault.lost: %s has fallen - the attack on %s is over
gipfeliarmy.army.march.too_far: That chunk is off your map
gipfeliarmy.army.siege.taken: Chunk [%s, %s] is yours — the squad holds it
gipfeliarmy.army.post.placed: Guard post set — click it to station guards
gipfeliarmy.army.post.title: GUARD POST [%s %s %s]
gipfeliarmy.army.post.recall.hover: Every guard here falls back in with you
gipfeliarmy.army.post.mode.defend.hover: Shoots monsters and anything that starts a fight
gipfeliarmy.army.post.mode.aggressive.ho: Also shoots any player within the watch who is not on your side or your team
gipfeliarmy.army.post.gone: There is no guard post there
gipfeliarmy.army.role.rifleman.hover: Letony-Mate-AK47 — bursts, decent reach. The standard.
gipfeliarmy.army.role.assault.hover: Shotgun — walks right in and takes a beating.
gipfeliarmy.army.role.marksman.hover: Long rifle — hangs back, one hard hit.
gipfeliarmy.army.role.bomber.hover: Launcher — homing Gipfäli. Won't fire point blank.
gipfeliarmy.army.role.panzer.hover: Heavy MG — slow, armoured, endless fire.
gipfeliarmy.army.role.marcher.hover: The banner — no gun, but everyone near it is faster, harder and tougher.
gipfeliarmy.army.formation.loose.hover: No shape — they bunch up behind you
gipfeliarmy.army.formation.line.hover: A rank abreast behind you, clear field of fire
gipfeliarmy.army.formation.wedge.hover: Arrowhead at your back, the banner at its point
gipfeliarmy.army.formation.column.hover: Single file — for tunnels, bridges and narrow paths
gipfeliarmy.army.formation.circle.hover: A ring around you, facing out
gipfeliarmy.configuration.title: Gipfäli Army Configs
gipfeliarmy.territory.title: Territory
gipfeliarmy.territory.limit: Your territory is full: %s of %s blocks, and a chunk takes %s more
gipfeliarmy.territory.not_yours: This chunk belongs to %s, not you
gipfeliarmy.territory.not_here: You have to stand in a chunk to claim or capture it
gipfeliarmy.territory.capture.unclaimed: Nobody holds this chunk — claim it instead
gipfeliarmy.territory.capture.owner_offl: %s is offline, and territory can only be taken while its owner is on
gipfeliarmy.territory.capture.started: Capturing [%s, %s] from %s — hold the chunk for %s s
gipfeliarmy.territory.capture.cancelled: Capture of [%s, %s] cancelled — you left the chunk
gipfeliarmy.territory.capture.cancelled_: Capture of [%s, %s] ended — the claim is gone, so claim it yourself
gipfeliarmy.territory.notify.capture_sta: ⚠ %s is capturing your territory at chunk [%s, %s]!
gipfeliarmy.territory.notify.capture_fai: %s gave up capturing your territory at chunk [%s, %s]
gipfeliarmy.territory.screen.button.must: Stand in the chunk to do this
gipfeliarmy.territory.screen.button.capt: Hold the chunk for %s s to take it; the owner is warned
gipfeliarmy.territory.screen.army.open.h: The roster: every soldier, its kit and its orders — with this chunk as the place to send them
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.title: Gipfäli Army
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.button.bag.hover: Its armour and gun as slots: drag things from your inventory onto it, or back. Walk up to it first
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.empty: Nobody here — raise a squad with the command flag
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.dismiss.hover: Sends this soldier home — its kit comes back to you. Takes two presses
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.squad.dismiss.ho: Sends everyone in this tab home — their kit comes back to you. Takes two presses
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.colour.hover: Paint it %s — the colour is the squad it belongs to
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.raise.hover: Raises a new squad under a commander of its own, for %s Gipfäli
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.recruit.free: %s unarmed soldiers beside the commander, for nothing
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.send.hover: March them from the whole army to chunk [%s, %s] and hold it
gipfeliarmy.army.screen.too_far: Walk up to the soldier to open its kit bag
gipfeliarmy.territory.screen.not_loaded: Chunk not loaded on the server
gipfeliarmy.territory.screen.legend: Green: yours · Red: others · Orange: contested
gipfeliarmy.territory.screen.army.hint: March them to the selected chunk. Free ground they claim for you; somebody else's they lay siege to — as long as one of them stands in it, the capture runs as if you stood there yourself.
